deviations_from_card: Revision applied: the swallow is cleared by the next down and by an 'expire' input the hook sends in a setTimeout(0) after the up that armed it; a dedicated test pins it. Cases are 0-indexed (guards 4, 5, 7 as the card's body implies). The effect set grew beyond the card's list by halt (a press still stops inertia and cancels a flight, as before), coast and settle (the hook's tail after an up or a cancel); swallowClick is returned for a click input, plus a swallowsClick helper. Extra behaviours: a down under an id still held (up lost outside the scene) starts a fresh press; the lostpointercapture listener acts only when the scene itself lost capture (a child's implicit touch capture bubbles the event). Case 7 has no new test: it is the existing camera/semantic/flight files passing unchanged. Red-before for 0-6 is ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND (gesture.ts absent); the guards 4 and 5 were red only for that reason. KIT-GAPS note says Scene.tsx was the last copy of the workaround: variants/archify/Nodes.tsx named in R5-A1 no longer exists. Two commits as the card's rollback describes (kit feature, then atlas dropping holdPointer); the changelog line covers both. Total 809 lines incl. the 68-line ADR and docs (code 516, test 173).
notes: No sibling reds seen; every gate green first run. Not verified in a browser: the DOM half (capture at threshold, capture-phase click swallow, setTimeout(0) expiry relative to the platform's click dispatch) is untested by node and worth a hand check in atlas lanes and the template Levels. rig.moving now turns true at the drag threshold rather than on press. Lock taken and released for commit 446e131 only (ADR 0112).
